source_en: The light is extraordinary. You should see it from where I am. The same sunset, for months.
Sorry, I was talking to someone. He says you should be careful.
Don't be sad. It's very quiet where I am. You'll [[whisper:understand eventually]].
I've been trying. The road doesn't seem to go that direction.
He's been there the whole time. He says hello. He says goodbye.
I wrote you something. I don't remember writing it. Keep it.
